title: Kusanagi Nene — Gift From Above〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No one else should be here so...
Okay, all clear.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I am a little sad that the Christmas show's over already...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But standing on the stage... I remember every moment of it and still feel it inside me. I can almost hear the audience laughing and applauding...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really managed to sing like I used to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It might even be my favorite play that I've done so far...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was so much fun...
It almost seemed like a dream.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright.
Robo-Nene, you'll be my audience as usual...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep! Roger.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our stage may look like something that could get blown away by a strong breeze, but our shows are the crème de la crème!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you're wrong if you think Nene can't sing as well as you!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(After Tsukasa said that about me,
I just had to prove him right.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The only way we should get revenge is by putting on an amazing show that knocks her socks off!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa took me to a play when I was little and it was like a really amazing dream!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also saw my first play with my family. My sister was in poor health back then, but that day she felt well enough to go out. She was so happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She loved the play so much, I decided to become an actor so that I could cheer her up like that too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All those memories are flooding back...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I just came by to make sure you were okay, and I'm happy to see you're back in high spirits!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Me too! It's a weight off my mind to see you've overcome your slump.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Miku and MEIKO showed me that they really cared about me too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'm fine now. I have nothing to fear.
I'm no longer all by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have this crazy troupe of troublemakers...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (At first, I couldn't really get myself to go along with their antics...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But then I realized I'd be missing out if I didn't take part in their ridiculously weird shows.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now, I'm one of them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I never imagined things would turn out this way.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They'd better take responsibility for all this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene!! That was great!
You were so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was your best song yet!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You should have invited us to your performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What... Wh-When did you all get here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just when you started really getting into it. You were singing with so much joy, we all just stopped and listened.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even Emu managed to stay quiet until you finished.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, Nene's singing is just so beautiful♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You heard all of it...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm so embarrassed, I don't want them to look at me! I know, I'll hide behind Robo-Nene!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Robo-Nene... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, did you enjoy Nene's song too?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, I did! Nene, your singing is amazing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't want applause. Just hide me!
Your arms are too short to clap anyway!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were singing so confidently. Don't get all shy on us now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Be proud, Nene! You're just as good if not better than that girl from the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was just... Surprised to see you all and wasn't expecting an audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't care about being called a diva or whatever. But since we're all performing together, try not to embarrass me on stage, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you saying? Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's all keep having fun doing shows together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For sure...!
